chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel ibn Salih, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I heard a man saying to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): 'May I be your ransom! I am a man who has aged, and I have married a young virgin, and I have not yet entered upon her. I fear that when I enter upon her on my bed, she will dislike me due to my dye (hair color) and my old age.'

So Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'When you go in, instruct them before she comes to you that she should be in a state of wudu. Then you should not approach her until you have performed wudu and prayed two rak'at.'
Then glorify Allah, and send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. Then supplicate to Allah, and instruct those with her to say 'Ameen' to your supplication.

And say: 'O Allah! Grant me her affection, her love, and her pleasure, and make me pleased with her. Then unite us with the best of unions and the most intimate of alliances, for You love the permissible and dislike the forbidden.'
Then he (peace be upon him) said: 'And know that affection (al-ilf) is from Allah, and separation (al-firk) is from Satan, so that he may make disliked that which Allah has permitted.'
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended rituals and supplications for a husband to seek his wife's affection and unity according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) provides a spiritual remedy for marital anxiety, prescribing a specific sequence of purification, prayer, and supplication to foster *ilf* (affection) and *wudd* (love). This practice highlights the Shia emphasis on integrating physical intimacy with spiritual mindfulness, ensuring that the union is blessed and free from the distractions of Satan. The theological conclusion underscores that true marital harmony is a divine gift, contrasting it with the discord (*firak*) instigated by Satan to make the permissible seem repulsive.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel Bin Salih, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I heard a man and he was saying to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! I am a man who has aged, and I have married a young virgin and have not slept with her, and I fear that when I do sleep with her upon my bed, she would dislike me due to my (hair) dye and my old age’.

So Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘When you go over, so instruct them before they send her to you that she should happen to be in Wuzu, then you (as well) should not go to her until you have performed Wuzu; and you should pray two Rak’at of Salāt, then Glorify Allahazwj, and send Blessings upon Muhammadsaww and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww. Then supplicate to Allahazwj and instruct the one who is with her than she should say ‘Ameen’ upon your supplication, and say,

‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Grace me her kindness, and her cordiality, and her pleasure, and my pleasure with her. Then Gather between us with the best of the gathering, and the most joyful of the coalitions, for You<sup>azwj</sup> Love the Permissible and You<sup>azwj </sup>Dislike the Prohibited’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And know, that the union is from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the separation is from the Satan<sup>la</sup> , (so people) abhor that which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Permitted’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Salih from abu Basir who has said the following:

“I heard a man saying to abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, I am an aged man. I have married a virgin young woman. I have not gone to bed with her yet. I am afraid in bed that on finding me of such age and the dye on my beard she may dislike me.’
Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘When you are there, ask her before approaching you to take Wudu’. You also, should not approach her before taking Wudu’ and performing two Rak‘at Salah (prayer).

Thereafter, speak of glory of Allah and say, “Allahumma Salli ‘Ala Muhammad wa ‘Ali Muhammad (O Allah grant Muhammad and his family a compensation worthy of their serving Your cause).” Thereafter ask her and others present with her to say A’ min (O Allah grant his wishes).

Thereafter say, “O Lord, provide her enough reasons to be kind to me, love me and be happy with me and grant me enough reason to be happy with her, bring us together in the best form of gathering, and the happiest kindness; You love lawfulness and dislike unlawfulness.’”
The Imam then said, ‘You must bear in mind that kindness comes from Allah and hate comes from Satan so that people dislike what Allah has made lawful.’”
